name: subscribe_slack_new_channels
description: Subscribe this conversation to newly created public Slack channels in the linked workspace. Optional channelNameContains filters by a case-insensitive substring of the channel name. Re-subscribing updates the filter. After subscribing, state what you are waiting for and end your turn; the event arrives as a follow-up notification in this conversation.

channelNameContains.description: Only match channels whose name contains this case-insensitive substring. Omit to match every new public channel.
